The neighborhood kids teased her, chanting:
"Piggy Laosan, Piggy Laosan, eats her fish, eats her meat, round and rolling down the street!" 

That was a long time ago. After two years of hunger and hardship, she thought about going back to Revelry Hall, to the warmth, comfort, and silver platters. 
She's just waiting a hand—the one that would take her home again.
